track_moving_particles — PHARMA track op

• データ種: video → table

• 呼び出し: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.track_moving_particles(frames, *, threshold=0.045, max_displacement_px=10.0, min_area_px=2, static_threshold=0.055) (実装を直接呼ぶなら import vialops; vialops.track_moving_particles(frames, *, threshold=0.045, max_displacement_px=10.0, min_area_px=2, static_threshold=0.055)、台帳から引くなら opspharma.get("track_moving_particles"))

• GPU: なし(CPU 参照実装のみ)

使い方

画像列から粒子・気泡・静止したガラス傷を分け、軌跡表を返す。

Each frame is compared with the temporal median, so stationary scratches are reported from the median image and moving objects from residual components. Consecutive moving detections are linked greedily only within max_displacement_px; ambiguous or too-large jumps start a new track rather than being silently joined. A moving track whose fitted row velocity is negative is labelled bubble (image rows increase downward), otherwise particle. This is a conservative 2-D projection tracker, not an identity-preserving multi-object tracker through overlap/occlusion.

Returns a table with one row per detection: frame, track_id, object_class, centroid, area, and row velocity. Input must be a finite (T,H,W) sequence with at least three frames.
